source.text: revealed 19,469 total genes, of which only 3155 (~16.2%) are core
revealed 19,469 total genes, of which only 3155 (~16.2%) are core
In panel E, the y-axis is labelled 'Gene number' and bars are grouped under three study headings: (Eduardo et al. 2019), (Danesh et al. 2016) and (Filipe et al. 2018).
In panel E, under the Eduardo et al. 2019 definition, the core genome (>95%) contains 3155 genes.
In panel E, under the Eduardo et al. 2019 definition, the dispensable genome contains 7847 genes.
In panel E, under the Eduardo et al. 2019 definition, the unique genome contains 8467 genes.

expect: yes for the Eduardo et al. 2019 definition: core 3155 + dispensable 7847 + unique 8467 = 19,469, which is the text's total (p2.L107). The other two definitions in Fig. 2E (Danesh 2016, Filipe 2018) give different splits.
